subject: IdP consolidation & SCIM/SAML transition plan for Private Control Plane
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: IdP consolidation & SCIM/SAML transition plan for Private CP

Hi team —

Following our workshop last week with Acme, I've put together a concise plan to consolidate their two IdPs into the Private Control Plane (private CP) identity flow and to transition SCIM provisioning and SAML assertions with minimal disruption. See attached spreadsheet (idp-mapping-diff.xlsx) that highlights current attribute differences and proposed claim mapping.

Top asks:
- Laura: please validate the role->claim mapping (tab: proposed-mapping) and flag any feature owners that need explicit entitlements.
- Soojin/David: confirm whether we can support NameID vs. email-based subject for existing SAML flows (Acme currently uses persistent NameID in IdP-A).
- Rishi: we need a thumbs up on the canary window (48h dual-write) and approval to request the access addendum from Legal.

Proposed timeline (high level):
1) 7/5–7/9: final mapping signoff + SCIM delta strategy.
2) 7/12–7/16: implement SCIM webhooks + test sync to staging.
3) 7/19: canary cutover (dual-write; 48h observation).
4) 7/22: full cutover pending no regressions.

Attachment: idp-mapping-diff.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
Sr. Product Manager, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 10:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: IdP consolidation & SCIM/SAML transition plan for Private CP

Laura — thanks for the summary and the spreadsheet. A few technical notes from my side after parsing the mapping: 

- SAML NameID vs attribute subject: we can support both, but NameID->subject requires a deterministic reconciliation step for service accounts (we'll need a stable externalId mapping in SCIM to avoid orphaned service accounts). If Acme wants to continue using persistent NameID, we'll add a short-lived mapping bucket for 30 days during the canary to detect mismatches.

- SCIM approach: recommend a delta-first sync with event-driven webhook for user updates + periodic full reconciliation (every 24 hours) rather than full export on every change. This reduces blast radius for high churn. See attached: scim-sprint-outline.pdf (staging runbook + rollback).

- Service accounts and rotation: confirm where keys are stored. If Acme is using their KMS, we need the envelope public keys and rotation window. Otherwise, we can generate ephemeral tokens and rotate by policy.

Questions for Acme (Jordan):
1) Will your SAML responses include group membership in the assertion (attribute: groups)?
2) Do you plan to retain legacy IdP-A for service-to-service tokens after cutover?

Suggested canary behavior: 48h dual-write with monitoring on auth failures and SCIM sync errors. If errors exceed 0.5% of auth volume or a rate of 5 errors/minute sustained for 15 minutes, auto-roll back.

I'll schedule a 30-min sync tomorrow to walk through the scim-sprint-outline.

—
Soojin Lee
Manager, Identity Integrations
Redwood Inference
From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@acme.com>, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: IdP consolidation & SCIM/SAML transition plan for Private CP

Quick infra check from networking/ops perspective — noted a couple constraints that change the rollout mechanics: 

- Private CP endpoint will be behind an internal ALB in Acme's VPC. We need the TLS SAN updated to include the private FQDN that Acme will resolve locally (they will provide internal DNS entries). Cert rotation must be coordinated; recommend we push a cert-renew window the day before canary.

- VPC peering vs. PrivateLink: Acme prefers VPC Peering for now but can enable PrivateLink if we require cross-account endpoint isolation. Peering has slightly different MTU/route propagation behaviors — we'll validate path MTU for large SCIM payloads.

- Network ACLs: Acme's security team will restrict inbound to our control plane’s managed IPs. We need a final IP allowlist by 7/8 to avoid delaying canary.

I've attached a diff of the attribute mapping where I resolved several ambiguous group->role mappings (idp-mapping-diff.xlsx). Action items below: 

1) Soojin: produce a short runbook for cert rotation and IP allowlist update (owner: Identity). Due: 7/6.
2) Laura: confirm timeline for Legal access addendum so we can request DocuSign. Due: 7/1.
3) Jordan (Acme): confirm whether legacy IdP-A will remain writable and share expected weekly churn for users.

Also linking the tracking ticket: JIRA-7842 (Private CP IdP consolidation). Drive folder with artifacts: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cAcme-PrivateCP-Identity

Thanks —
David Kim
Senior Infrastructure Engineer, Private Deploys
Redwood Inference

Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: IdP consolidation & SCIM/SAML transition plan for Private CP

Thanks everyone — this looks good. Approving the 48h canary window and the rollback thresholds Soojin proposed. A few extra items from my side: 

- Legal: Laura, please loop in Legal for the access addendum today and request the DocuSign link. I want that signed before we start the canary.
- SLOs: we should mark a temporary relaxed SLO for auth latency for the 48h window (allow +30% variance) and call out a post-canary retro with Acme.
- Support: tag on-call and CS for the canary start; we'll do hourly check-ins for the 48h period.

Jordan — can you confirm by EOD that Acme will provide the internal DNS entries and the allowlist? Once we have that, Ops can schedule the cert rotation and we can lock down the cutover date.

If all good, proceed with runbook and DocuSign request.

-Rishi
VP, Product & Ops
Redwood Inference
